_doc: Materials the native renderers draw with, by name (native/src/render/render_context.h). Colours as '#rrggbb', textures as res:// paths. prop lens_roughness and lens_ior: the signal lens, polished polycarbonate (Physically Based database, physicallybased.info, 'Plastic (PC)': roughness 0, index of refraction 1.5848 from refractiveindex.info). Vegetation wind (vegetation.gdshaderinc): wind_speed_ms 3 = Beaufort 2, light breeze 1.6-3.3 m/s (WMO); sway_per_ms2 = top bend per (m/s)^2 from Peltola et al. 1993 (crown-centre bending under 5 cm on a 13.5 m pine at 8 m/s: 0.0037 of the height, times (1/0.6)^2 to the top, over 64); gust_m = 22 x 10 m (Kaimal et al. 1972 spectral peak n z / U = 1/22); turbulence = 1 / ln(10 m / 0.05 m) (EN 1991-1-4 eq. 4.7, terrain category II); sway_hz = natural frequency of leafy trees of 8-15 m, 0.2-0.3 Hz (Jackson et al. 2019). wind_dir_x and wind_dir_z: a unit vector; the map has no geographic north, so no climate record applies to the way the wind blows. vegetation_cards cover_per_mip 0.25: alpha rescaled by mip level so a card keeps its coverage far away (Golus 2021, Anti-aliased Alpha Test: The Esoteric Alpha To Coverage). vegetation roughness 0.85: modelling choice for matte leaves, no published value.

agent._doc: Vehicles. Lamp colours: head_glow a halogen headlamp bulb, a black body at 3200 K (Philips H4 standard bulb); tail_glow the corner of UNECE R48 §2.30 red (y <= 0.335, z <= 0.008: x 0.657, y 0.335); sign_glow the middle of R48 amber (0.398 <= y <= 0.429 on z = 0.007), each from CIE 1931 (Wyman, Sloan & Shirley 2013 fit) to sRGB, out-of-gamut parts clipped, the brightest channel at 1. brake_ratio: a stop lamp at least 5 times its rear position lamp (UNECE R7 §6.2.4.2). Roughness (physicallybased.info): paint 0 (Car Paint: clear topcoat), lens 0 for lamps, signs and the far level's glass (Plastic (PC), Glass), skin 0.5 (Skin I-VI), helmet 0 (Plastic (PC) shell), trim 0.7 (Tire) for every unpainted part, cloth 1 (a matte textile: the database has none). head_power, tail_power, sign_power: how bright the lit lamps draw, set on the night photo (05_transito at 10_noite): a lamp's brightest channel at the top of the display range without bleeding into its body.

agent_glass._doc: Vehicle glass (agent_glass.gdshader): transmittance 0.70, the least a windscreen and the windows the driver needs may let through (CONTRAN Resolução 960/2022 art. 4º I); ior 1.52, soda-lime glass, roughness 0 (physicallybased.info Glass).
